_comment: Item catalogue. 'colour' is the placeholder render colour (RRGGBB) - see docs/ASSETS.md.

items.name: Soil Blade
items.description: A short mattock rated for frozen regolith. Breaks ground for planting.

items.name: Mist Canister
items.description: Pressurised meltwater. One squeeze soaks a planted tile for the day.

items.name: Cutting Torch
items.description: Cuts salvage free and cracks mineral crusts.

items.name: Field Scanner
items.description: Reads module diagnostics and wakes dormant data slates.

items.name: Scrap Alloy
items.description: Hull plate offcuts. The colony is built out of what the colony broke.

items.name: Silica Shard
items.description: Wind-polished glass from the hollows. Sharp, clear, oddly warm.

items.name: Resin Fibre
items.description: Tough strands pulled from native stalks. Seals, binds, insulates.

items.name: Lumen Shard
items.description: A crystal that holds a faint charge. It dims when the air is dry.

items.name: Salvaged Cell
items.description: A power cell someone pulled and stacked neatly before leaving.

items.name: Filter Mesh
items.description: A woven scrubber panel. Catches spores the recycler cannot.

items.name: Sealing Gel
items.description: Slow-setting compound for pressure seams.

items.name: Circuit Lattice
items.description: A printed lattice board. Fiddly, fragile, indispensable.

items.name: Lumen Pod Seed
items.description: Plant in tilled soil. Sprouts fast and glows faintly at night.

items.name: Glassroot Seed
items.description: A heavy seed with a mineral shell. Slow, thirsty, worth it.

items.name: Cinder Moss Spore
items.description: Thrives on neglect. Watering it does nothing at all.

items.name: Orbit Berry Seed
items.description: Slow to establish, but the vine keeps bearing once it takes.

items.name: Lumen Pod
items.description: A soft-shelled pod that keeps a day's worth of light in it.

items.name: Glassroot
items.description: A translucent tuber. Snaps cleanly, tastes of cold metal.

items.name: Cinder Moss
items.description: Dry, rust-red matting. Burns slow and clean.

items.name: Orbit Berry
items.description: Grows in slow rings around the stem, like a tiny system.
